safety_invariant: No experiment may remove the user's ordinary recovery surface unless an independent recovery path for that exact failure class has already been validated.

recovery_tiers.name: APP_PROCESS_OR_PACKAGE
recovery_tiers.goal: Revert an app/user-space change without rebooting the device.

recovery_tiers.name: ANDROID_BOOTED_ADB_REACHABLE
recovery_tiers.goal: Recover when UI/display/launcher/input behavior is degraded but Android and the external debug channel remain reachable.

recovery_tiers.name: ANDROID_BOOTED_UI_UNUSABLE
recovery_tiers.goal: Use host-side recovery to disable/revert the exact changed component and reboot into a known-good state.

recovery_tiers.name: NORMAL_ANDROID_BOOT_UNAVAILABLE
recovery_tiers.goal: Use Samsung-supported recovery/download mechanisms and a separately documented host-side restore plan.

promotion_rule: A mutation class can move from BLOCKED to ALLOWED_FOR_BOUNDED_TEST only after its recovery drill passes and evidence is recorded.
